in_marathi.name: Anvay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anvay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anvay is a name derived from Sanskrit origin which means 'friend' or 'companion'. In Hindu mythology, Anvay is the name of Lord Krishna's childhood friend and loyal companion, Sudama.
